integrity: Analytic all-length proof; finite rational tests are corroboration only. No independently performed validation is asserted.
limitations: Exact endpoint and uniform birth rate only; the analytic result does not guarantee stage positivity, timestep accuracy, floating-point robustness, unequal rates or general generators. Self-review only, with residual historical-coverage risk.
scientific_context: Complete finite-length, exact-step positivity classification of the standard [2/2] Gauss–Legendre Padé endpoint on absorbing unit-rate pure-birth generators; the complete n=8 case is previously published and not claimed as new.
title: The thirteen-state feasibility cutoff for fourth-order Padé steps on absorbing birth chains
